profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a public company founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, trading under the ticker CRM. Its most recent 10-K, covering the period ending 2026-01-31, reports revenue of $41,525,000,000. The website material for the company is Slack's AI features page, which describes AI built into its messaging product.

On that page the company describes Slack AI as a way to summarize channels and threads, serve daily recaps, search files, take meeting notes, translate conversations, and create automations, with Slackbot presented as a personal AI agent that adapts to a user's tone and style. The company says customer data is not used to train large language models, that LLM providers do not have access to customer data, and that the models are hosted within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud. It also says Slack is the conversational interface for Agentforce, with agents built in Agentforce running in Slack channels, threads, and direct messages, and that AI features are available across all paid Slack plans. Other tracked products are Tableau AI (Einstein), described as business intelligence embedded AI with natural language queries, CRM data integration, and Trust Layer governance, and Salesforce Einstein / Agentforce, described as CRM-embedded AI and agents.

Third-party MCP servers registered for Salesforce include ai.cirra/salesforce-mcp for administration and management, several ai.smithery/kodey-ai-salesforce-mcp variants for running SOQL queries against a Salesforce org, and cloud.serpent/salesforce-devops for planning deploys, opening pull requests, and triggering pipelines from an AI client. The company's litigation exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281.
